programme.title: Zoo Clues
programme.desc: With all of the various animal species roaming around the planet there's a lot to know about animals, which means no one knows everything about them. Thankfully "Zoo Clues" fills in some of the blanks. Each half-hour episode investigates at least a dozen questions about animals to provide viewers with answers. Have you ever wondered if birds can fly backward, how animals without external ears hear, or why zebras have stripes? Those are among the questions waiting for answers on "Zoo Clues."

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth
programme.desc: If you're expecting this show to feature locations like Antarctica and the North Pole, you may be disappointed because the "coolest" in the title refers to how impressive a place is, not its temperature. Instead, the show explores the history and culture of cities and landmarks that are among the most astonishing sites on the planet. Each episode features three locations, showcasing the history, geography and traditions of each to help young people gain a better understanding of the diverse world in which they live.

programme.title: Naked And Afraid: Aadimanav
programme.desc: The endurance and psychological limits of six survivalists are pushed to the brink as they navigate various challenges in a bid to survive the unforgiving wilderness of Palawan, Philippines.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: True Conviction
programme.desc: Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi examines cases through the eyes of a prosecutor and shares her insights into how the complex threads of a murder investigation come together in the courtroom.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: The TikTok Man: Catching a Predator
programme.desc: Over a decade, a predator in Denmark has used social media as his hunting ground, leading to over 400 reports of online sexual harassment, violence and rape. Victims share their stories as one mother works to build what could be a landmark case.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
programme.desc: America's top legal and outlaw distillers go head-to-head in the ultimate booze-making competition, to see who has what it takes to join the ranks of the greats and win the title of master distiller.

programme.title: Curse of the Bermuda Triangle
programme.desc: Bermuda Triangle is home to some of the most fascinating unsolved mysteries on Earth. This remote territory in the Atlantic Ocean has been the subject of notoriety and legend as countless ships, planes and human lives have been lost in its waters.

programme.title: Ancient Unexplained Files
programme.desc: Ancient investigations turn tech as specialists harness an advanced digital forensics lab and use the latest scientific discoveries to solve the biggest mysteries of ancient history.

programme.title: You Have Been Warned
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: Crime Scene Confidential
programme.desc: Revisiting controversial and shocking murder cases from across the country by taking a fresh look at the forensic evidence, with the hope to bring more clarity to these complex crimes, and closure to those the victims left behind.

programme.title: Ancient Unexplained Files
programme.desc: Ancient investigations turn tech as specialists harness an advanced digital forensics lab and use the latest scientific discoveries to solve the biggest mysteries of ancient history.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.desc: In this 13-part documentary series, hosts Scott Wilson and Ellis Emmett descend beneath the surface to explore the three-quarters of the planet that is covered in water. Each episode features a new location, where Wilson and Emmett discover all that the area has to offer. They explore the cultures of the local people, share stories of human triumph and tragedy, and connect the world on land to the one in the sea. With each dive into the unknown, they encounter creatures and sights that most people will never get to experience.

programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: True Conviction
programme.desc: Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi examines cases through the eyes of a prosecutor and shares her insights into how the complex threads of a murder investigation come together in the courtroom.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రాంతీయ, జాతీయ వార్తల సమగ్ర సమీక్షను అందిస్తుంది, సంబంధిత సమస్యలు, సమాజంపై వాటి ప్రభావాన్ని పరిశీలిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఫ్యామిలీ స్టార్స్
programme.desc: ఒక ఛానల్ కు చెందిన కళాకారులు సరదా టాస్క్‌లు, ఛాలెంజ్‌లలో ఉత్సాహంగా పాల్గొంటూ, పరిశ్రమలో తమ అనుభవాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: ఢీ
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత ఆహ్వానించిన ఔత్సాహిక నృత్యకారులలో టైటిల్ గెలుచుకోవడానికి పోటీపడే అత్యుత్తమ ప్రదర్శనకారులను ఎంపిక చేస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీదేవి డ్రామా కంపెనీ
programme.desc: ప్రతిభావంతులైన కళాకారులు కామెడీ స్కిట్లు, నృత్యాలు, ప్రమాదకరమైన విన్యాసాలను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: సరాగాల పల్లకి
programme.desc: ప్రేక్షకులను అలరించడం కోసం, టాలీవుడ్ సినిమాల నుండి అత్యంత ప్రజాదరణ పొందిన సరికొత్త పాటల సమగ్ర సంకలనం ప్రసారం.

programme.title: యోగ సూత్ర
programme.desc: ఒక యోగా నిపుణుడు, వివిధ యోగా భంగిమలను అభ్యసించే సాంకేతికతను చూపుతూ, వీక్షకులకు వాటి ఉపయోగాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: సూర్య పుత్ర కర్ణ
programme.desc: సూర్య భగవానుడు,కుంతిదేవి కొడుకు కర్ణుడు, మహాభారతంలో గౌరవనీయ వ్యక్తిగా ఎదగడానికి సవాళ్లతో నిండిన మార్గాన్ని అనుసరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: సామ్రాట్ అశోక
programme.desc: బిందుసారుడి కుమారుడు అశోకుడు, చాణక్యుడి మార్గదర్శకత్వంలో ఎదురైన సవాళ్లు, కష్టాలను అధికమిస్తూ మగధను పాలిస్తాడు.

programme.title: రాగం తానం పల్లవి
programme.desc: సంగీత ప్రియులు ఎన్నో రకాల సాంప్రదాయ గీతాలను, జనాదరణ పొందిన సినిమా పాటలను ఆస్వాదిస్తారు. ఇవి అందరినీ ఎంతగానో అలరిస్తాయి.

programme.title: జీవన జ్యోతి
programme.desc: ఆయుర్వేద నిపుణులు యోగా ద్వారా సంపూర్ణ ఆరోగ్య ప్రయోజనాలను పొందడంపై సలహాలను అందిస్తూ, పలు రుగ్మతలకు చికిత్సలను సూచిస్తారు.

programme.title: భాగ్యలక్ష్మి బంపర్ డ్రా
programme.desc: దురదృష్టవంతుడైన లాటరీ విక్రేత బుల్లబ్బాయి, తాగుబోతు యేసుదాస్ జాక్‌పాట్ కొట్టినప్పుడు ఆ లాటరీ డబ్బును కాజేయాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: సింహాద్రి
programme.desc: వర్మ కుటుంబం తమ సొంత బిడ్డలా పెంచిన సింహాద్రి తన పెళ్లి రోజున తన కాబోయే భార్యను వేరే అమ్మాయి కోసం వదిలేస్తాడు.

programme.title: సరైనోళ్ళు

programme.title: అభిమన్యు

programme.title: సింహాసనం

programme.title: ఫ్యామిలీ స్టార్స్

programme.title: చెప్పాలని ఉంది

programme.title: My Secret,Terrius Ep.1 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Koh Ae-rin, a mom that quit her job a long time ago, starts looking for a job to make a living when her husband suddenly passes away. While doing something no one asked her to at her new job, she finds out a secret of the Korean office of Cornerstone, an international military industrial complex. She gets involved with Kim Bon, the man next door that has been chasing after a huge conspiracy and involuntarily becomes a member of Kingsbag, a special organization within the National Intelligence Service(NIS). She grows rapidly within the world of intelligence, which had seemed like a totally different world to her, and shows great performance that even surprises the NIS agents.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the hottest newtro master PARKMOONCHI! PARKMOONCHI became known to the public through the variety show Hangout with Yoo where she displayed her exceptional ability to put her own contemporary spin to 1990s music. That sensational appearance led her to actively collaborate with numerous big names in the music scene including Suho and Baekhyun from EXO Kang Daniel Kwon Jin Ah and Young K from Day6. Also known for her witty and unexpectional point of view PARKMOONCHI shares with everyone how the Generagion MZ enjoys the music and culture of older generations - no wonder how she became an icon of MZers. In September this year PARKMOONCHI released a new EP named ParkRuRa with RuRu and RaRa. Combining R&B new jack swing and soul music the three musicians also known as PARKMOONCHI UNIVERSE show off their unique yet beautiful universe under their motto Pursuing joy and happiness together In this episode PARKMOONCHI performs m e s s a g e . . . and Move! from the album ParkRuRa her cover of Lee Ye-rin's Come On Baby Tonight as well as I Want To Hold Your Hand and The Story Of The Year with Onewoo. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this delightful and unpredicted artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is talented vocalist BAEK A YEON! Known for her crystal clear voice BAEK A YEON made her big debut in 2012 after making it to the top three of the popular talent search show K-Pop Star in 2011. Then she dominated the top spots of various music charts and shows with the song Shouldn't Have... which she wrote at the end of a disappointing relationship. After that she released more songs about love oftentimes unrequited love including Looking For Love and so-so which has eventually become her own genre. In this episode BAEK A YEON performs Shouldn't Have... so-so Sweet Lies a Good Boy Jealousy and 0% the lead single off her latest album Observe. Tune in to I'm LIVE and fall in love with her crystalline voice once again!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter eldon! This artist became known to the public after taking part in the TV program Superstar K Season 7 where he made it to the top 5. Then in 2016 he officially made his debut as the vocalist of Martin Smith and once again surprised the public with his rhythmical vibes and songwriting skills. 2 years later in 2018 he started his career as a solo artist under his new stage name eldon. From his debut single Ghost! to Pink cheeks to Do monsters love too? he has already released an impressive set of albums which are full of his personal feelings and experiences. Also Pink cheeks was featured in the hit TV series My Roommate Is a Gumiho and widened his reach in the industry. In this episode eldon performs Pink cheeks Back to you and more to show off his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet eldon!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE are four guys performing under the slogan of “chaotic world warm music” - it's Nerd Connection! This band is composed of four graduates of Yonsei University one of the most prestigious universities in Korea. The beginning was almost accidental - Vocalist Seo Yeong-ju and guitarist Choi Seung-won began performing together in 2012 as part of the university's rock band club Medusa. Then bassist Park Jae-hyun and drummer Shin Yeon-tae joined the band and they made their step into the professional music scene with their first single Hymn of the Birds in 2018. The same year they took part in the Emergenza Festival the world's largest festival for unsigned bands. After several regional qualifiers in Korea they passed the Korean qualification which led to the finals at a festival in Germany. With that unbelievable milestone at the very beginning stages of their career the four have pleasantly surprised listeners both at home and abroad until now. In October this year Nerd Connection released their first full-length album. All 12 songs in the album are tied under the concept of nostalgia for things gone by touching listeners in their unique way. In this episode the quartet performs 21st Century Kingdom Hollywood Movie Star Waterfall Bamboo Forest and Good Night Good Dream. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet the four highly talented musicians!

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.
